functions.description: Extract timestamp, host, pid, severity and message from the base IOFilterVPD log line
Extract user and source IP when the message contains a user@ip pattern (e.g. user=root@10.20.4.51 or user svc_backup@192.168.55.20)
Extract source IP from messages referencing a remote host or connection origin without an accompanying user (e.g. 'from 203.0.113.44 rejected' or 'from host 198.51.100.77')
Normalize severity, classify action based on message content, and derive event time from the extracted timestamp

add.name: action
add.value: message && message.match(/rejected|blocked|Repeated authentication failures/) ? 'blocked' : message && message.match(/approved|accepted|Successfully registered|completed|started successfully|applied/) ? 'allowed' : message && message.match(/failed|Failed|crashed|timeout|expires|signature verification failed/) ? 'error' : 'info'
